اقتحمن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَحَمْنَ (iqtaḥamna) /iq.ta.ħam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اُقْتُحِمْنَ (uqtuḥimna) /uq.tu.ħim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اِقْتَحِمْنَ (iqtaḥimna) /iq.ta.ħim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
